map.TRAb 与 TSI 一样吗？: Are TRAb and TSI the same?
map.TRAb 是受体抗体总称，TSI（刺激性抗体）是其致病亚类；临床报告多为 TRA: TRAb is the general term for receptor antibodies, and TSI (stimulating antibody) is the pathogenic subclass; clinical reports usually give total TRAb, and an elevated level supports Graves disease.
map.母体 TRAb 可经胎盘刺激胎儿甲状腺，中晚孕期监测有助于预测新生儿甲亢并指导新: Maternal TRAb can cross the placenta and stimulate the fetal thyroid, so monitoring in the second and third trimesters helps predict neonatal hyperthyroidism and guide newborn follow-up.
